cases.name: zero-muzzle-velocity -> trajectory never reaches target -> large undershoot (negative miss), finite
very-high-velocity -> large overshoot (positive miss), still finite
straight-up (90 deg) with any v0 -> x barely moves -> strongly negative miss
near-horizontal (1 deg) -> lands very short -> strongly negative miss

sweep.note: miss distance is expected to increase monotonically with v0 (faster shot, farther landing point) at fixed angle - a monotonicity check the gate can actually verify.
